changelog: NEW (DEV-ONLY, Phase 2): Bake TMDB poster + backdrop images into the APK. Top 100 popular movies + top 100 popular TV shows × (poster + backdrop) = 372 bundled WebP images (~28 MB). Coil mapper short-circuits any TMDB image URL whose path is bundled, so popular-title posters paint instantly with zero TMDB CDN round-trip. APK grows 25 MB → 53 MB (dev only). Canada / official: untouched.

FIX: Re-wired HushBundleMapper into Coil's ImageLoader components — was previously defined but never registered, which silently bypassed the existing 44-entry streaming/decade/theme bundle. Now both that bundle AND the new Phase 2 image bundle are active.
INHERITED v1.44.128-debug: Bake static API JSON (sports schedules, TMDB top-popular metadata, themes pack) into the dev APK.
INHERITED v1.44.127: Auto cache-clear on launch.
INHERITED v1.44.125: Fire Stick black-screen-on-play fix.
